Data collection is not instantaneous. A doctor doesn't immediately code the death the second the patient passes away. He does it when he finally gets a moment to sit down and chart a death and fill out the death certificate. Sometimes that's delayed because an autopsy is needed to determine official cause of death. The reporting functions on EHR software are not automatic either. They might run once daily at a low usage time or once weekly to report to the state. The state compiles the numbers and reports to CDC. Those systems aren't instantaneous either. The numbers will change as data comes in. We should expect that.
